STRATEGY_1.name: Trend Following
conditions: Use when 5M and 30M slopes align in the same direction
Use when volatility is expanding or stable
Use when price is trending away from session support/resistance

STRATEGY_2.name: Mean Reversion
conditions: Use when price is at extreme levels relative to session range
Use when volatility is contracting after expansion
Use when price is near previous session support or resistance

STRATEGY_3.name: Breakout
conditions: Use when price breaks above resistance or below support
Use when volatility is suddenly expanding
Use when there is clear structure to trade against

selection_rules: Analyze the market context and indicators to determine the best strategy
Consider the current session and previous session levels
Look at swing points to understand market structure
If conditions are unclear, prefer STRATEGY_1 (Trend Following)
